2608.10606.title: ASR-Roundtrip Evaluation Can Mask Context- and Convention-Dependent Reading Errors in Chinese News TTS
2608.10606.paper_summary: ASR-roundtrip evaluation is widely used as a scalable proxy for text-to-speech (TTS) intelligibility, but it can produce false negatives for reading errors perceived by listeners. We study Chinese news TTS spans whose correct reading depends on context or domain conventions, such as sports scores, aircraft models, technical units, and membership names. In these cases, Raw TTS can choose a plausible but wrong reading while ASR transcribes the audio as the intended or surface-correct text. A targeted audit over 110 high-risk MiMo TTS cases, reported with a complete denominator, confirms 46 masked false negatives, 9 exposed TTS errors, and 55 cases with no Raw TTS error. A span-isolation diagnostic re-exposes 18/46 previously masked errors. A Raw-only CosyVoice audit on the same targeted pool confirms 51 masked cases. Across the 97 TTS-specific audio files labeled confirmed masked across the two audits, Qwen3-ASR surface-recovers 40 cases, whereas Paraformer does so in only 2. The results suggest that ASR-roundtrip is useful for screening but insufficient as standalone ground truth for Chinese news reading-risk evaluation.
2608.10606.paper_summary_zh: ASR回合評估被廣泛用作文本到語音（TTS）可懂度的可擴展代理，但它可能對聽眾感知的閱讀錯誤產生假陰性。我們研究中文新聞TTS範疇，其正確閱讀依賴於上下文或領域慣例，例如體育比分、飛機型號、技術單位和會員名稱。在這些情況下，原始TTS可能選擇一個似是而非但錯誤的閱讀，而ASR則將音頻轉錄為預期或表面正確的文本。對110個高風險MiMo TTS案例進行的針對性審核，報告了完整的分母，確認了46個隱藏的假陰性、9個暴露的TTS錯誤，以及55個沒有原始TTS錯誤的案例。一個範疇隔離診斷重新揭露了18/46個之前隱藏的錯誤。對同一目標池進行的僅原始CosyVoice審核確認了51個隱藏案例。在97個標記為在兩次審核中確認隱藏的TTS特定音頻文件中，Qwen3-ASR表面恢復了40個案例，而Paraformer僅恢復了2個。結果表明，ASR回合評估對篩選有用，但作為獨立的中國新聞閱讀風險評估的真實基準則不足。
2608.10606.author: Shijun Luo et.al.
